# CodePiper

> Orchestrate multiple AI coding sessions from a single daemon.

CodePiper is an open-source remote orchestrator for managing multiple live interactive coding-agent sessions. Built with Bun + TypeScript. Everything runs locally on your machine.

## Key Features

- **Multi-Session Control**: Start, stop, attach, resume, and send text to any number of concurrent sessions from CLI or web dashboard
- **Web Dashboard**: Real-time terminal view, conversation rendering, analytics, and session management
- **Permission Policies**: Auto-approve or deny tool use via glob pattern rules with full audit log
- **Multi-Device Access**: Start on your laptop, monitor from your phone, respond from your iPad, attach from raw tmux
- **Workflow Orchestration**: Chain multi-session tasks via YAML/JSON DSL with sequential, parallel, conditional, and loop steps
- **Token Analytics**: Track token usage, model distribution, cache efficiency, and estimated cost across all sessions
- **Git Integration**: Browse diffs, stage files, view commit history from the session's git tab
- **Worktree Isolation**: Spawn sessions in git worktrees with auto-branch creation for parallel agents
- **Secure & Local-First**: SQLite database, encrypted secrets, no cloud accounts, no telemetry, MFA built in

## Supported Providers

- **Claude Code**: Native hooks, transcript tailing, model switching
- **Codex CLI**: tmux integration with input-preflight policy enforcement

## Quick Start

```bash
npm i -g codepiper
codepiper daemon --web
# Open http://localhost:3000, complete onboarding
codepiper start -p claude-code -d ~/projects/my-app
```
